title: The Fishyscapes Benchmark: Measuring Blind Spots in Semantic Segmentation
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for anomaly detection in semantic segmentation for urban driving, directly addressing 'safety-critical applications like autonomous driving' to ensure 'safety and reliability'. The entire purpose of the benchmark is to measure how well methods detect 'potentially hazardous anomalies', which is a core component of ensuring the ethical and safe deployment of AI systems in real-world scenarios.
